cards.example: Magtatatag ang Ombudsman ng panel para sa pagsubaybay sa badyet ng gobyerno.
cards.exampleMeaning: The Ombudsman will set up a panel to monitor the government's budget.
cards.note: Pangngalan mula sa 'subaybay'; may kahulugang tuloy-tuloy na pagbabantay, hindi minsanang pagsilip. Madalas sa ugnayang 'pagsubaybay sa' + paksa, gaya ng badyet, presyo, o kaso.
cards.tiesTo: Ombudsman budget watch panel after the Supreme Court struck down the budgets

cards.meaning: swapped with each other; traded places
cards.example: Nagpalitan ng puwesto sina Dizon at Lopez sa gabinete.
cards.exampleMeaning: Dizon and Lopez swapped posts in the cabinet.
cards.note: Pandiwang may unlaping 'nag-' at 'pag-' na nagpapahiwatig ng dalawang panig na kapwa gumawa; kaiba sa 'nagpalit' na iisang tao ang nagbago.
cards.tiesTo: Dizon and Lopez swapping DOTr and DPWH

cards.example: 尽管消费不振，电子行业的盈利还是大幅增长。
cards.examplePinyin: Jǐnguǎn xiāofèi bùzhèn, diànzǐ hángyè de yínglì háishi dàfú zēngzhǎng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Even though consumption is weak, profits in the electronics industry still grew sharply.
cards.note: Both noun and verb, common in business writing. Contrast 利润 (the profit figure on a statement) with 盈利 (the state of making money, or the act); the opposite is 亏损.

cards.pinyin: yǔ qí shuō... bù rú shuō...
cards.meaning: rather than say X, it's better to say Y
cards.example: 与其说这是复苏，不如说这是少数行业的繁荣。
cards.examplePinyin: Yǔqí shuō zhè shì fùsū, bùrú shuō zhè shì shǎoshù hángyè de fánróng.
cards.exampleMeaning: Rather than call this a recovery, it's better to call it a boom in a few sectors.
cards.note: Abstract reframing connective, slightly formal; it corrects a label rather than choosing between actions. Contrast 与其……不如……, which weighs two courses of action.
cards.tiesTo: Reframing China's profit surge as narrow, not broad recovery
